engines._note: build: codex | claude. review must differ from build. Codex runs through the build-codex skill.

budget._note: Stop hook warns when one session passes this many million tokens (input incl. cache + output).

post_edit._note: Commands for the file just edited, {file} = its path. Empty = off. Set by the conventions skill, e.g. format: "npx biome format --write {file}", lint: "npx eslint {file}".

ui._note: quick: one direction on the chosen design system + moodboard, 1 critique round. full: 3 directions, 2 critique rounds, optional v0 exploration, visual regression baselines.

roles._note: Who does each role: claude | codex | deepseek. review must differ from build. Machine-specific overrides (e.g. deepseek at home only) go in .flow/config.local.json, which is git-ignored.

codex._note: inplace: Codex edits the main working tree while Claude does non-code work (no second node_modules, no install inside the sandbox). worktree: only for real parallel slices; the conductor prepares the worktree (install, db) before handing it over. Codex can never write .git: the conductor commits.

deepseek._note: Used when a role is set to deepseek (usually only in config.local.json on a machine where the API is reachable).

_checks_note: checks: fast (lint, typecheck), run by the Stop hook only when code changed since the last pass. checks_full: everything (tests, e2e), run in verify.
